capture-command.description: Shell that writes $SHOTS_OUT/captures.json plus its PNGs.

projects.description: Dynamic affected-project JSON array. Each object requires a stable `id` and may set `current`, `verify`, `manifest`, and `gallery-title`. Capture roots must remain beneath shots/. Empty preserves the existing single-capture workflow.

container.description: Container image the capture runs in (pin to your Playwright version).

screencomp-version.description: screencomp release to install on the host, or "latest".

arches.description: ADVANCED / testing override for the capture arch matrix, as a JSON array string (e.g. '["x86_64"]'). Leave empty (the default) for the normal single-source flow, where the matrix is read from [capture].arches in the committed screencomp.toml. Set it only when there is no committed config to read — e.g. screencomp's own reusable-workflow self-test, which has no repo-level screencomp.toml.

verify.description: Capture twice and require byte-identical output (the reproducibility gate).

pages.description: Deploy the gallery to GitHub Pages (canonical on push, per-PR preview on PRs).

pages-repository.description: External owner/name repository that hosts the galleries. Empty uses this repository.

publish.description: Perform external side effects: post the PR comment, push the regenerated manifest, and deploy Pages. Set false to run every step but produce no side effects — a dry run for previewing or for testing the workflow.

gh-pages-maintenance.description: Keep the gh-pages branch bounded: delete a PR's /pr-<n>/ preview when the PR closes (cleanup-preview) and prune gh-pages history to the most recent gallery versions on a schedule (prune-history; see gh-pages-history-versions). On by default — set false to opt out (e.g. you serve Pages from a source other than the gh-pages branch, or prune it with your own tooling). Only fires when the caller also forwards the matching `pull_request: closed` and `schedule:` triggers; the `screencomp init` scaffold does. Also gated on pages + publish, so dry runs skip it.

gh-pages-history-versions.description: How many of the most recent gallery versions (gh-pages commits) the scheduled prune-history job keeps intact; everything older is collapsed into a single base commit. 0 collapses the branch to one fresh commit. Ignored when gh-pages-maintenance is off.

fail-on-drift.description: Fail the job when the capture drifts from the committed baseline manifest (the strict gate, default). The developer regenerates and commits the baseline locally with the pre-push guard; CI is the backstop that goes red on anything they missed. Set false to auto-accept drift instead — a loud warning, not a failed check (the lighter model, where changes can slip through unnoticed).

update-manifest.description: Regenerate the baseline manifest and, on a PR when publishing, push it to the PR branch. Off by default: under the strict gate the developer owns the baseline. Turn it on (with fail-on-drift:false) for the CI-auto-accept model, where CI moves the baseline for you.

comment-base-ref.description: Git ref whose committed manifest is the PR comment's "Before". Defaults to the PR base branch, so the sticky comment shows the intended before/after even though classify gates against the (already-updated) committed baseline. Set to a single space or an unknown ref to fall back to diffing the committed manifest.

comment-mode.description: `per-project` (default) posts one sticky before/after comment per project lane — correct, but a monorepo with N affected projects gets N comments per PR. `aggregated` instead posts a SINGLE comment covering every affected project (one row each with its counts and its own gallery link, plus a combined summary), upserted in place by one stable marker. The per-project galleries and Pages output are identical either way; only the PR-comment surface consolidates. Recommended for many-project monorepos.

push-token.description: Token that can trigger workflows, used to push the regenerated manifest to the PR branch. Only needed when the repo enforces required status checks (the default GITHUB_TOKEN cannot trigger runs). See the README's "Branch protection".

pages-token.description: Token with contents:write on pages-repository. Required when pages-repository is set.

steps.name: Validate external Pages configuration
Resolve [capture].arches
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [ -n "$ARCHES_OVERRIDE" ]; then
  matrix="$ARCHES_OVERRIDE"   # explicit override (no committed config to read)
else
  matrix="$(screencomp arches --format json)"
fi
if [ -z "$matrix" ] || [ "$matrix" = "[]" ]; then
  echo "::error::no [capture].arches configured in screencomp.toml; add e.g. arches = [\"x86_64\"], or pass the workflow's 'arches' input" >&2
  exit 1
fi
projects="$PROJECTS_INPUT"
if [ -z "$projects" ] || [ "$projects" = "[]" ]; then
  projects='[{"id":"","current":"shots/current","verify":"shots/verify"}]'
else
  if ! jq -e '
    def safe_capture_path:
      type == "string" and length > 0 and
      startswith("shots/") and
      (contains("\\") | not) and
      (split("/") | all(. != "" and . != "." and . != ".."));
    def safe_relative_path:
      type == "string" and length > 0 and
      (startswith("/") | not) and
      (contains("\\") | not) and
      (split("/") | all(. != "" and . != "." and . != ".."));
    type == "array" and length > 0 and
    all(.[];
      type == "object" and
      (.id | type == "string" and test("^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$")) and
      ((has("current") | not) or (.current | safe_capture_path)) and
      ((has("verify") | not) or (.verify | safe_capture_path)) and
      ((has("manifest") | not) or (.manifest | safe_relative_path)) and
      ((has("gallery-title") | not) or
        (."gallery-title" | type == "string" and length > 0))) and
    ([.[].id] | length == (unique | length))
  ' <<<"$projects" >/dev/null; then
    echo "::error::projects needs unique non-empty IDs, capture roots under shots/, safe relative manifests, and non-empty gallery titles" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
fi
combined="$(jq -cn --argjson arches "$matrix" --argjson projects "$projects" --arg title "$DEFAULT_TITLE" '
  {include: [
    $arches[] as $arch | $projects[] |
    {
      arch: $arch,
      project: .id,
      current: (.current // ("shots/current/" + .id)),
      verify: (.verify // ("shots/verify/" + .id)),
      manifest: (.manifest // (if .id == "" then "" else "shots/baseline/" + .id + "/" + $arch + ".json" end)),
      gallery_title: (."gallery-title" // $title)
    }
  ]}')"
echo "matrix=$combined" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Log runner CPU (cross-CPU anti-aliasing drift diagnostics)
steps.run:
echo "::group::Runner CPU ($(uname -m))"
grep -E -m1 'model name' /proc/cpuinfo \
  || grep -E 'Model|CPU implementer|CPU part' /proc/cpuinfo | sort -u \
  || true
echo "::endgroup::"

steps.name: Capture again for the reproducibility gate

with.name: ${{ matrix.project && format('screencomp-shots-{0}-{1}', matrix.project, matrix.arch) || format('screencomp-shots-{0}', matrix.arch) }}
${{ matrix.project && format('screencomp-shots-{0}-{1}', matrix.project, matrix.arch) || format('screencomp-shots-{0}', matrix.arch) }}

with.pages-artifact: ${{ matrix.project && format('screencomp-gallery-{0}-{1}', matrix.project, matrix.arch) || format('screencomp-gallery-{0}', matrix.arch) }}
